excerpt.zh: 随着[LastKilledCountryName]的覆灭，他们作为星海共同体监管人的任期也不复存在了。
excerpt.en: With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], their Custodianship of the Galactic Community has come to an end.

texts.zh: 随着[LastKilledCountryName]的覆灭，他们作为星海共同体监管人的任期也不复存在了。
texts.en: With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], their Custodianship of the Galactic Community has come to an end.

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

texts.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
texts.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

label.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。
